response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with nearly 20 years of experience, but their profile is heavily oriented toward web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang). Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and there is no evidence of MQTT, message brokers in an industrial context, IEC 62443/SDL practices, or industrial-automation protocols, which are core to this role.
strengths: Extensive overall engineering experience across web, embedded, and low-latency systems
Proven performance-engineering skills (async I/O, caching, high-throughput services in DLang)
Strong mentoring, testing culture (TDD), and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: Minimal recent professional C++ experience (last hands-on C++ role ended in 2015)
No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) or industrial protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Career trajectory focused on web/full-stack and AI tooling, misaligned with automation-machinery domain

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation or IEC 62443 background
